features.title: Features
features.subtitle: Everything you need to node your services — without installing an agent on any target.
features.heroTitle: Seven reasons to node with us
features.heroSubtitle: From probe diversity to dark-mode RTL — built for teams that care about reliability and craft.
features.typesSubtitle: No agent on the target server — define the target and we do the rest.
features.liveBody: Results arrive in the console the moment a probe completes. No polling, no refresh button — a persistent SSE stream pushes status, latency and metrics to every open dashboard.
features.locationsBody: Run the same check from FRA, AMS and THR so a local network blip is never confused with a real outage. Configure per-node locations and compare results side by side.
features.chartsBody: Every probe result is stored. Latency, success rate and P95 percentile charts are available across three ranges. Drill into individual results for full request/response details.
features.schedulingBody: Configure the probe interval (down to 10 s for HTTP), a per-node timeout and up to 5 automatic retries. Nodes can be paused and resumed without losing history.
features.ssrfBody: All targets are validated before execution. Private, reserved and link-local IP ranges are blocked at both validation and dial time — TOCTOU-safe. No target ever reaches internal infrastructure by accident.
features.statusPagesBody: Create public status pages from any set of nodes. Give each page a custom slug, choose which nodes to show and share the link with your users — no extra infrastructure required.
features.i18nBody: The entire platform is built for Persian (RTL) and English (LTR) from day one. Every label, date and chart adapts to the active locale, and both light and dark themes cover every screen.

security.title: Security
security.subtitle: A transparent summary of the security measures implemented in the platform today — not aspirational, not planned.
security.ssrfBody1: Every node target is validated before a probe is enqueued. The validation layer blocks targets that resolve to private, reserved, link-local or loopback addresses.
security.ssrfBody2: The worker performs a second check at dial time — after DNS resolution — so that a DNS rebinding attack that slips past validation is still caught before any packet reaches a protected network. This is the TOCTOU-safe guarantee.
security.validationBody1: Targets are parsed and normalised before any probe is scheduled. Invalid URLs, malformed hostnames and disallowed schemes are rejected at the API layer with clear error messages.
security.validationBody2: Per-type constraints — minimum intervals, required fields and format checks — are enforced server-side so a malformed probe definition never reaches the scheduler.
security.authBody1: User sessions use short-lived access tokens (JWT) and longer-lived refresh tokens stored in HttpOnly, Secure, SameSite cookies. The refresh token is rotated on every use; a stolen refresh token is invalidated the moment the legitimate owner makes their next request.
security.authBody2: Google OAuth 2.0 and one-time passcode (OTP) login over SMS are the two supported identity providers.
security.workerBody: Probe workers authenticate to the control plane with a pre-shared token. This token is scoped to result ingestion only — it cannot read or modify nodes, users or configuration.
security.redactionBody: Probe results carry a rich set of attributes (headers, certificates, DNS records). Before rendering, the console redacts fields that could contain credentials or tokens so that operators never accidentally expose secrets in screenshots or shared views.
security.rateLimitBody: The OTP send and verify endpoints are rate-limited per phone number and per IP address to prevent brute-force and SMS-flooding attacks.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.section1Body: We collect the minimum information needed to operate the service: your phone number or email (for login), the nodes you define (targets, configurations) and the probe results generated by those nodes. We do not collect analytics, track your behaviour or use third-party marketing scripts.
privacy.section2Body: We use your information solely to provide the monitoring service: authenticating you, executing the probes you configure, storing results so you can view charts and history, and delivering status pages you choose to make public. We do not sell, rent or share your data with third parties.
privacy.section3Body: We use HttpOnly cookies to store authentication tokens. These cookies are essential for the service to function — they keep you signed in and protect your session. We do not use tracking cookies, advertising cookies or third-party cookies of any kind.
privacy.section4Body: Probe results are retained according to the retention period of your plan (7, 30, 90 or 365 days). When you delete a node, its result history is permanently removed. When you delete your account, all associated data is deleted within 30 days.
privacy.section5Body: All data is stored on infrastructure we control. Probe results may contain headers and response bodies captured from your targets — this data is stored as-is and is visible only to authenticated users in your account. We apply the security measures described on our Security page to protect your data.
privacy.section6Body: We use Google OAuth as an optional sign-in method. When you sign in with Google, we receive your name and email address. We do not access your Google account beyond what is needed for authentication.
privacy.section7Body: If you have questions about this privacy policy or would like to exercise your data rights, contact us through the platform's support channels.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.section1Body: The Monitoring Platform ("the Service") is an agentless monitoring tool that lets you define probes (HTTP, TCP, DNS, Ping, TLS, Domain Expiration, SMTP and NTP), schedule their execution and view the results through a web console or public status pages.
terms.section2Body: You agree not to use the Service to probe targets you do not own or have explicit permission to node. You are responsible for ensuring that your use of the Service complies with the laws of your jurisdiction. We reserve the right to suspend accounts that probe targets in a way that generates abuse complaints.
terms.section3Body: You are responsible for maintaining the security of your account credentials. You must notify us immediately if you believe your account has been compromised. We are not liable for any loss or damage arising from unauthorised access to your account.
terms.section4Body: The Service is provided on an "as is" and "as available" basis during the current development phase. We do not guarantee uninterrupted access or error-free operation. We may suspend the Service for maintenance, updates or emergency fixes with reasonable effort to provide advance notice.
terms.section5Body: We may update these terms from time to time. Material changes will be communicated through the platform or by email. Your continued use of the Service after changes take effect constitutes acceptance of the updated terms.
terms.section6Body: To the fullest extent permitted by law, the Monitoring Platform and its operators shall not be liable for any indirect, incidental, special, consequential or punitive damages arising from your use of the Service. Our total liability for any claim related to the Service is limited to the amount you paid us (if any) in the twelve months preceding the claim.
